title: Travel: John Lennon – London to Los Angeles | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from London to Los Angeles on 23 April 1970.

The purpose of the trip was to embark on a course of primal therapy with Dr Arthur Janov at the Primal Institute on 620 N Almont Drive in LA. Lennon and Ono had already completed an introduction to the course in England.

The flight arrived at 7.15pm. Lennon and Ono travelled as Mr and Mrs Chambers, and while in LA they stayed in a bungalow at the Beverly Hills Hotel. They had informed the US Embassy in London that they intended to travel to New York City on 7 May and return to London before 16 May.
